# dsh-always-on-top
English | 中文
> A pin button for the DSH Desktop title bar: click once to keep the window above every other window
, click again to release it.
A small DSH plugin — one host route and one client script. No dependencies, no build step, ~30 KB un
DSH plugin — one host route and one client script. No dependencies, no build step, ~30 KB unpacked.

## Features

- A pin button in the title bar, immediately left of the Windows minimize button
- Toggles always-on

-top through the Win32 `WS_EX_TOPMOST` window style
- Turns blue while pinned; the tooltip reads "Al

ways on top — click to unpin"
- Remembers the state and re-applies it on the next launch
- Hides its
elf when not running inside DSH Desktop on Windows

## Usage
The pin sits at the right end of the title bar, left of the minimize button:

- grey: not pinned
- blue: always on top
Click to toggle. Tooltips follow the system language (English / Chinese).
## How it works
DSH Desktop is an Electron app, so the window belongs to the Electron main process. The plugin runs
in the DSH host process, which the main process spawns — therefore `process.ppid` is exactly the pro
cess that owns the window.

1. Click → the client sends `POST /dsh-always-on-top/toggle`
2. The host resolves the main window ha

ndle with `Get-Process -Id <ppid>`
3. A short PowerShell script calls `user32!SetWindowPos` to set o

r clear `WS_EX_TOPMOST` (`HWND_TOPMOST` / `HWND_NOTOPMOST`)
4. The host reads `GetWindowLong(GWL_EXS
TYLE)` back and only reports success when the bit actually changed
No Electron changes, no main-process injection, no undocumented APIs.
## Compatibility
| | Requirement |

| OS | Windows 10 / 11 |
| Runtime | DSH Desktop (Electron) |
| DSH | 0.2.x (`dsh.client` injection)
, tested on 0.2.1-rc.2 |
The button stays hidden in `dsh web` (browser) and on other operating systems.
### After a DSH upgrade
The button is positioned for the current title bar (42 px tall, ~138 px of window controls). If a fu
ture DSH release changes the title bar, adjust two numbers in the CSS in `lib/client.js`:

- button too far left/right or overlapping minimize → `right` (currently `146px`)
- button too high/
low → `top` (currently `7px`)
## Limitations
- A toggle takes ~0.4–0.6 s (a PowerShell process compiles the P/Invoke declaration); the button sho

ws a busy state
- State lives in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-always-on-top.json` (default `~/.dsh/`)
- Only the m
ain window is affected; the welcome screen and update dialogs are not
